chunks: O sister of Aaron, your father was not a wicked person, nor your mother sinful!

key_terms.أُخْتَ هَارُونَ: Sister of Aaron (title of respect and lineage)
key_terms.ابْنُ مَعْنٍ: Son of Imran (referring to her father)

ai.seo_question: Why is Maryam called 'Sister of Aaron' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this address is understood as a metaphorical designation rather than literal siblinghood, linking Maryam to the priestly lineage of Harun to emphasize her spiritual purity and continuity with the Prophetic tradition. The phrase 'What was your father a man of evil?' serves to validate the moral integrity of Imran, while 'and what was your mother a chaste woman?' affirms the chastity of Hannah (Anne), thereby refuting accusations of illegitimacy regarding her miraculous birth. This dual affirmation underscores the divine selection of her family line, a concept central to the Shia understanding of the Ahl al-Bayt's inherent purity (Ismah).
